_note: Curated big channels whose long-form audience skews adult men 18-35 (the channel's target audience) and whose scripting/retention craft is worth stealing. Grouped by what we borrow from them. Add/remove freely; find_general_outliers.py skips handles that fail to resolve.

social_experiment.why: Stranger interaction, social risk and real reactions on camera: closest big-channel analogue to infield/video-chat footage.

mens_self_improvement.why: Talking-head persuasion scripted for men: the explainer format's retention ceiling.

story_explainer.why: Documentary-style narrative scripting: open loops, chaptering, payoff placement.

niche_authorities.why: The user's reference cold-approach and video-chat creators (see memory project_niche_channels_cold_approach). Lower view floor, longer lookback: these are niche-sized channels.
